name: Moving day
source:
Daryl has to go into witness protection after his situation where he came from became too hot. Landing in a new city is always difficult, but knowing you're a wanted man makes it so much worse.

None of this is helped by calls from strangers telling him to "watch out" or the janitor who shows up out of nowhere. 

Daryl now has to figure out who to trust and how he is going to 
maneuver this strange situation while remaining safe.

[From [url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/moving-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达里尔（Daryl）来自的处境变得过于激烈，因此必须接受证人保护。登陆一个新城市总是很困难，但知道自己是通缉犯会让情况变得更糟。

陌生人打电话告诉他“小心”，或者突然出现的看门人，这一切都无济于事。

达里尔现在必须弄清楚该信任谁以及他将如何信任 
在保持安全的情况下应对这种奇怪的情况。

[来自[url=https://mystery-zone-games.itch.io/moving-day]Itch.io[/url]]
